utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey guys, sorry I'm late. So the repair drive is still this Saturday at 10, right?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yep, still Saturday at 10 at the community center. I've been tallying supplies—we're in good shape.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, thanks for confirming. Anything specific you need me to bring or help with?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: The repair drive is this Saturday from 10 AM to 4 PM at the community center on 5th Street.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'll bring my tools. Do you need anything specific?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Check with Sam about the tool list; Gus already has wrenches and screwdrivers covered.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Nell, are you planning to come to the Repair Drive on Saturday? I heard Eli might be there to help with basic carpentry.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that sounds great! I'd love to come, and I heard Uli's bringing some tools too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, Uli's tools will come in handy. What are you planning to bring for repair?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Still on for Saturday at 10?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, isn't it Sunday at the community center? Did we change it?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No, it's Saturday. Same time, 10 AM.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Heard the repair drive is this Saturday at the community center, sounds like a good plan.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh yes, it's going to be great! I'm helping out, and Nell's doing small electronics, Gus is lending tools, and Cleo's on parts.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, nice! I think Daria is also collecting tools for the workshop, might be good to coordinate.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, I'll drop my stuff off Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, I'll bring my box of assorted screws too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, see you Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive! It's this Saturday at the community center, right? I should check with Cleo about the parts inventory.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, Cleo's handling the parts, and Gus is bringing tools.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, Gus with tools. I almost forgot to bring my own wrench. Do we need anything else?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Faye, are you coming to the repair drive this Saturday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, I'll be there! I'm bringing snacks for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That's great, Faye! I'm sure everyone will appreciate the snacks.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I hope we have enough time before Saturday to sort through all the screws.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, just a note—the repair drive is actually on Sunday, so we have an extra day to sort those screws. Sam's helping with the tools.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Wait, I thought it was Saturday... are you sure it's Sunday?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Sam, I grabbed the flyers for the repair drive. Want to help me put them up at the coffee shop and library?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with that. After we're done, I need to check on the tool organization at Opal's garage.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, let's head to the coffee shop first, then the library. How's the tool organization going at Opal's?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good morning, Kira. I just wanted to confirm the repair drive is still set for Saturday at the community center—I've got my tools ready for the door fixes.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You sure about that? I heard Quinn mention it, but I haven't seen any official sign-up sheet yet.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, I'm certain. Gus and Rey are bringing the tools, and Sam is organizing everything with Uli. No need for a sign-up sheet—we've got it all planned out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I already put up flyers at the community center. Need me to tell more folks about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, please do spread the word. And just to double-check, the flyers mention it's this Saturday at the community center on 5th Street, right?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yep, all the details are on there: this Saturday at the community center on 5th Street. I'll make sure to chat up everyone I see.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: So the repair drive is this Saturday at the community center on 5th Street, right?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Actually, it's on Sunday at the community center. I can help you find the details if you need.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oh, I thought it was Saturday. Are you sure it's Sunday? I had it down as the 5th Street community center on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Is the repair drive still on for Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, still on Saturday. I've got the snacks covered.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good. Do we have enough tools for the carpentry work Eli could help with?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'll bring my tool set to the repair drive on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, I thought it was on Sunday? Did it change?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: No, it's definitely Saturday. I checked the flyer Quinn posted.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I'm just finishing up the supply tally. Uli's tools helped a lot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that's great! I almost forgot we had those tools. So we're all set for Saturday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Almost! I'm just putting together the list of needed supplies for Rosa, then we'll be ready.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Jules, are you coming to the repair drive? We're gathering tools at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: You bet I'll be there! I'm picking up some flyers to spread the word at the coffee shop and library.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Awesome, Jules! The more folks we reach, the better the turnout.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh hey Dane! Did you hear about the repair drive this Saturday? I'm helping out, and Nell's doing small electronics and sewing.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I heard about it. Sounds good — I'll try to make it on time for once.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great! Gus is lending his wrenches and screwdrivers, and Cleo's on parts inventory.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I hope we have enough screws for Saturday; it would be a shame if we run out mid-repair.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Rosa made a list, so we should be covered. I'll double-check the supply box tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Leo. Let's also make sure Hana confirms with Cleo on the count; I'd hate for us to be short.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: The repair drive is this Saturday from 10 AM to 4 PM at the community center on 5th Street.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, Gus and Eli are coming? And Cleo's handling parts?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Actually, Sam helps organize tools, and Jules posts flyers. I'm not sure about Eli or Cleo handling parts.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard Gus has his wrenches all set for the repair drive—should be a good turnout!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, and Cleo's got the parts inventory sorted, and Tess is helping out too. Saturday at the community center, right?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That's right, Saturday! I heard Eli's coming too—should be a real community effort.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Eli! I'm glad you're asking about the repair drive. It's this Sunday at the community center, and Sam is already organizing the tools.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Wait, Rosa, I thought it was Saturday at the community center. Are you sure about Sunday? I've got my schedule set for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, Eli, it's definitely Sunday. I'm sorry for the confusion—let Sam and everyone know about the change.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive is on Saturday at the community center. I'll be there to help.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure it's Saturday? I thought I heard something about a different day.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I'm pretty sure it's Saturday—I saw the flyer when I was at the store this morning.
